Name: Crusty Garlic Bread
Description: Crusty bread grilled with olive oil, rubbed with garlic while hot, finished with flaky salt.
Ingredients:
Crusty bread, sliced
Olive oil
Garlic cloves, peeled
Flaky sea salt
Steps:
**Grill or toast** the bread with olive oil until crisp.
**Rub** with garlic cloves while it's hot.
**Finish** with flaky sea salt.
Facts:
Used in: [[vegetable-soup|Vegetable Soup]]
Original: Our own recipe

Name: Vegetable Soup
Description: Root veggies, squash and stewed tomatoes in broth, with crusty garlic bread.
Ingredients:
Garlic
Onion
Celery
Carrot
Parsnip
Butternut squash
Potatoes
Canned stewed tomatoes
Broth
Broccoli
Peas
## To serve
[[garlic-bread|Crusty Garlic Bread]]
Steps:
**Aromatics.** Saute the garlic, onion, celery and carrot in a little olive oil until soft.
**Simmer.** Add the parsnip, squash, potatoes, tomatoes and broth. Simmer until tender, about 20-25 min.
**Green veg.** Add the broccoli and peas for the last 5 min.
**Serve** with [[garlic-bread|Crusty Garlic Bread]].
Note: No amounts in the original; eyeball it.

Name: Snack Plate Builder
Description: Pick from each group and a healthy snack plate dinner is done.
Ingredients:
## Protein (pick 2)
Hard-boiled eggs
Cheese cubes
Smoked salmon or tuna
## Crunch (pick 1)
Nuts, seed crackers or sourdough
## Fresh (pick 2)
Peppers, cucumber, carrots, grapes, apple
## Briny (pick 1)
Pickles, olives or pepperoncini
## Dip (pick 1)
Hummus, tzatziki or chili oil
Steps:
**Protein first.** Two proteins make it a meal.
**Add** fresh and crunch.
**Finish** with something briny and a dip.
Facts: Formula: 2 protein, 1 crunch, 2 fresh, 1 briny, 1 dip
